2017 Airstream Flying Cloud Front Bed Queen (27').

This is a clean, well-maintained Airstream. It has been stored in a covered, enclosed storage unit. We love this trailer but our lifestyle has changed. 

We lived in this trailer and traveled the country for a year. We used it for some volunteer work in 2023 and 2025. I also take it camping at least once a year to exercise all the systems. All systems go. Shouldn’t everything work? 

This unit has Portland Airstream’s Grand Lounge modification. We did that in 2018. This modification removed the long couch and replaced it with a six-drawer cabinet. It also upgraded the dining table, seats, cushions, and under-dinette cabinets with factory-matching materials. I have pads for the dinette to run it into a bed.

Lots of little extras and nice-to-have items are included with the sale, eliminating a lot of nickel and dime expenses when buying and outfitting an RV. Like the ad states, all the adapters, pads, monitors, regulators, extensions, etc. are included. Dishes, sheets, towels – you can have it with the sale or it goes to the thrift store. If you’re new to RVing, this is huge. 

All maintenance manuals, maintenance records, and receipts for this trailer. Two sets of keys. Spotless interior. This is a clean, well-maintained and loved Airstream that is ready to camp.

If also interested in the 2016 F-250 shown, ask me. But the trailer goes before or with the truck.
